in_marathi.name: Anmolika
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anmolika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anmolika is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘anmol’ meaning ‘precious’ and ‘ika’ meaning ‘one’. In Hindu mythology, this name is given to a child who is considered a precious gift from the gods.
